text: Gunahon ki bakhshish mango aur Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana karo: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke badi umar wale mujahideen ke sath sath Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) mujhe bhi shamil kar liya karte the, toh shayad kisi ke dil mein is ki kuch narazgi paida ho gayi. Usne kaha ke yeh hamare sath na aaya karein, in jitne toh hamare bache hain. Khalifatul Muslimeen (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum inhe khoob jante ho. Ek din sab ko bulaya aur mujhe bhi yaad farmaya, main samajh gaya ke aaj inhe kuch batana chahte hain. Jab hum sab ja pahunche toh Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) ne hum se pucha ke Surah Iza Ja'a ki nisbat tumhein kya ilm hai? Baaz ne kaha is mein hamein Allah ki hamd-o-sana bayan karne aur gunahon ki bakhshish chahne ka hukm kiya gaya hai ke jab madad-e-Allah aa jaye aur hamari fatah ho toh hum yeh karein, aur baaz bilkul khamosh rahe. Toh aap ne meri taraf tawajjah farmayi aur kaha kya tum bhi yahi kehte ho? Main ne kaha nahin. Farmaya phir aur kya kehte ho? Main ne kaha yeh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke inteqal ka paigham hai. Aap ko maloom karaya ja raha hai ke ab aap ki dunyawi zindagi khatam hone ko hai, aap tasbeeh, hamd aur istighfar mein mashghool ho jaiye. Hazrat Farooq (R.A) ne farmaya yahi main bhi janta hoon. (Sahih Bukhari). Jab yeh Surah utri toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha ke ab isi saal mera inteqal ho jayega, mujhe mere inteqal ki khabar di gayi hai. (Musnad Ahmad). Mujahid, Abu Al-Aliyah, Zahhak wagaira bhi yahi tafsir bayan karte hain. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina Sharif mein the, farmane lage Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allah ki madad aa gayi aur fatah bhi, Yaman wale aa gaye. Pucha gaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Yaman wale kaise hain? Farmaya woh narm dil log hain, suljhi hui tabiyat wale hain, imaan toh Ahl-e-Yaman ka hai aur samajh bhi Ahl-e-Yaman ki hai aur hikmat bhi Ahl-e-Yaman walon ki hai. (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab yeh Surah utri, chunke is mein aap ke inteqal ki khabar thi, toh aap ne apne kamon mein aur kamar kas li aur taqreeban wahi farmaya jo upar guzra. (Tabrani). Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke suraton mein poori surat nazil hone ke aitbar se sab se aakhri surat yahi hai. (Tabrani). Aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh surat utri aap ne is ki tilawat ki aur farmaya log ek kinara hain, main aur mere as-hab ek kinara mein hain. Suno fatah-e-Makkah ke baad hijrat nahin, albatta jihad aur niyat hai. Marwan ko jab yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ne sunayi toh yeh kehne laga jhoot kehta hai. Us waqt Marwan ke sath us ke takht par Hazrat Rafe bin Khadij aur Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) bhi baithe the, toh Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) farmane lage in dono ko bhi is hadith ki khabar hai, yeh bhi is hadith ko bayan kar sakte hain, lekin ek ko toh apni sardari chhin jane ka khauf hai aur dusre ko zakat ki wasooli ke ohday se sabakdosh ho jane ka dar hai. Marwan ne yeh sun kar koda utha kar Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ko marna chaha. In dono buzurgon ne jab yeh dekha toh kehne lage Marwan sun, Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ne sach bayan farmaya. (Musnad Ahmad). Yeh hadith sabit hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne fatah-e-Makkah ke din farmaya hijrat nahin rahi, haan jihad aur niyat hai, jab tumhein chalne ko kaha jaye uth khade ho jaya karo. (Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim). Sharif mein yeh hadith majood hai. Haan yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jin baaz sahaba ne Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ke samne is surat ka yeh matlab bayan kiya ke jab hum par Allah Ta'ala shahar aur qilay fatah kar de aur hamari madad farmaye toh hamein hukm mil raha hai ke hum is ki tareefein bayan karein, is ka shukr karein aur is ki pakeezgi bayan karein, namaz ada karein aur apne gunahon ki bakhshish talab karein, yeh matlab bhi bilkul sahi hai aur yeh tafsir bhi nihayat pyari hai. Dekho Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne fatah-e-Makkah wale din duha ke waqt aath rakat namaz ada ki. Go log yeh kehte hain ke yeh duha ki namaz thi, lekin hum keh sakte hain ke duha ki namaz aap hamesha nahin padhte the, phir us din jabke shughl aur kaam bahut zyada tha, musafirat thi, yeh kaise padhi? Aap ki iqamat fatah ke mauqa par Makkah Sharif mein Ramzan Sharif ke aakhir tak unnis din rahi, aap farz namaz ko bhi qasr karte rahe, roza bhi nahin rakha aur tamam lashkar jo taqreeban das hazar tha isi tarah karta raha. In haqaiq se yeh baat saaf sabit ho jati hai ke yeh namaz fatah ke shukriye ki namaz thi. Isi liye sardar-e-lashkar, imam-e-waqt par mustahab hai ke jab koi shahar fatah ho toh dakhil hote hi do rakat namaz ada kare. Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ne fatah-e-Madain wale din aisa hi kiya tha. In aath rakaat ko do do rakat kar ke ada kare, go baaz ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke aathon ek hi salam se padh le, lekin Abu Dawood ki hadith sarahatan marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is namaz mein har do rakat ke baad salam phera hai. Dusri tafsir bhi sahi hai jo Ibn Abbas (R.A) wagaira ne ki hai ke is mein aap ko aap ke wisal ki khabar di gayi ke jab aap apni basti Makkah fatah kar lein jahan se in kuffar ne aap ko nikal jane par majboor kiya tha aur aap apni aankhon apni mehnat ka phal dekh lein ke faujon ki faujein aap ke jhande tale aa jayen, joq dar joq log halqa-ba-gosh-e-Islam ho jayen toh hamari taraf aane ki aur hum se mulaqat ki tayariyon mein lag jao. Samajh lo ke jo kaam hamein tum se lena tha poora ho chuka, ab aakhirat ki taraf nigahain dalo jahan aap ke liye bahut behtari hai aur is duniya se bahut zyada bhalai aap ke liye wahan hai, wahin aap ki mehmani tayar hai aur mujh jaisa mezban hai. Tum in nishanat ko dekh kar bakasrat meri hamd-o-sana karo aur tauba-o-istighfar mein lag jao. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se marwi hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne ruku-o-sajde mein ba-kasrat Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika Allahummaghfirli padha karte the. Aap Quran ki is ayat Fasabbih bihamdi Rabbika par amal karte the. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni aakhri umar mein in kalmat ka aksar wird karte the: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilaih. Allah ki zaat pak hai, isi ke liye sab tareefein mukhtas hain, main Allah se istighfar karta hoon aur us ki taraf jhukta hoon. Aur farmaya karte the ke mere Rabb ne mujhe hukm de rakha hai ke jab main yeh alamat dekh loon ke Makkah fatah ho gaya aur deen-e-Islam mein faujein ki faujein dakhil hone lagin toh main in kalmat ko ba-kasrat kahoon, chunancha bihamdillah main ise dekh chuka, lehaza ab is wazifay mein mashghool hoon. (Musnad Ahmad). Ibn Jarir mein Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni aakhri umar mein baithte uthte, chalte phirte, aate jate Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi padha karte. Main ne ek martaba pucha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ki kya wajah hai? Toh aap ne is surat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya mujhe hukm-e-Ilahi yahi hai. Kisi majlis mein baithein phir woh majlis barkhast ho toh kya padhna chahiye, ise hum apni ek mustaqil tasneef mein likh chuke hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jab yeh surat utri toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ise aksar apni namaz mein tilawat karte aur ruku mein teen martaba yeh padhte: Subhanakallahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika Allahummaghfirli innaka antat-tawwabur-raheem. Fatah se murad yahan fatah-e-Makkah hai, is par ittefaq hai. Umooman Arab qabail isi ke muntazir the ke agar yeh apni qaum par ghalib aa jayen aur Makkah in ke zer-e-nageen aa jaye toh phir in ke Nabi hone mein zara sa bhi shuba nahin. Ab jabke Allah ne apne Habib ke hathon Makkah fatah kara diya toh yeh sab Islam mein aa gaye. Is ke baad do saal bhi poore nahin hue the ke sara Arab musalman ho gaya aur har ek qabile mein Islam apna raaj karne laga, Falhamdulillah. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhi Hazrat Umar bin Salama ka yeh maqoola majood hai ke Makkah fatah hote hi har qabile ne Islam ki taraf sabqat ki. In sab ko isi baat ka intezar tha aur kehte the ke inhe aur in ki qaum ko chhodo, dekho agar yeh Nabi-e-Barhaq hain toh apni qaum par ghalib aa jayen ge aur Makkah par in ka jhanda nasb ho jayega. "Hum ne ghazwa-e-fatah-e-Makkah ka poora poora waqia tafseel ke sath apni Seerat ki kitab mein likha hai, jo sahib tafseelat dekhna chahein woh is kitab ko dekh lein." Falhamdulillah. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ke padosi jab apne kisi safar se wapas aaye toh Hazrat Jabir (R.A) un se mulaqat karne ke liye gaye. Unhon ne logon ki phoot aur in ke ikhtilaf ka haal bayan kiya aur in ki nau-ijad bid'aton ka tazkira kiya toh Sahabi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye aur rote hue farmane lage ke main ne Allah ke Habib, Shafe-e-Roz-e-Jaza Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fidahu abi wa ummi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke logon ki faujon ki faujein Allah ke deen mein dakhil huin lekin anqareeb jamaton ki jamatein in mein se nikalne bhi lag jayengi. Is surat ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah-e-ala ihsanihi.

Toh aap ne meri taraf tawajjah farmayi aur kaha kya tum bhi yahi kehte ho? Main ne kaha nahin. Farmaya phir aur kya kehte ho? Main ne kaha yeh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke inteqal ka paigham hai. Aap ko maloom karaya ja raha hai ke ab aap ki dunyawi zindagi khatam hone ko hai, aap tasbeeh, hamd aur istighfar mein mashghool ho jaiye. Hazrat Farooq (R.A) ne farmaya yahi main bhi janta hoon. (Sahih Bukhari). Jab yeh Surah utri toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha ke ab isi saal mera inteqal ho jayega, mujhe mere inteqal ki khabar di gayi hai. (Musnad Ahmad). Mujahid, Abu Al-Aliyah, Zahhak wagaira bhi yahi tafsir bayan karte hain. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina Sharif mein the, farmane lage Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allah ki madad aa gayi aur fatah bhi, Yaman wale aa gaye. Pucha gaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Yaman wale kaise hain? Farmaya woh narm dil log hain, suljhi hui tabiyat wale hain, imaan toh Ahl-e-Yaman ka hai aur samajh bhi Ahl-e-Yaman ki hai aur hikmat bhi Ahl-e-Yaman walon ki hai. (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab yeh Surah utri, chunke is mein aap ke inteqal ki khabar thi, toh aap ne apne kamon mein aur kamar kas li aur taqreeban wahi farmaya jo upar guzra. (Tabrani). Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke suraton mein poori surat nazil hone ke aitbar se sab se aakhri surat yahi hai. (Tabrani). Aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh surat utri aap ne is ki tilawat ki aur farmaya log ek kinara hain, main aur mere as-hab ek kinara mein hain. Suno fatah-e-Makkah ke baad hijrat nahin, albatta jihad aur niyat hai. Marwan ko jab yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ne sunayi toh yeh kehne laga jhoot kehta hai. Us waqt Marwan ke sath us ke takht par Hazrat Rafe bin Khadij aur Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) bhi baithe the, toh Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) farmane lage in dono ko bhi is hadith ki khabar hai, yeh bhi is hadith ko bayan kar sakte hain, lekin ek ko toh apni sardari chhin jane ka khauf hai aur dusre ko zakat ki wasooli ke ohday se sabakdosh ho jane ka dar hai. Marwan ne yeh sun kar koda utha kar Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ko marna chaha. In dono buzurgon ne jab yeh dekha toh kehne lage Marwan sun, Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ne sach bayan farmaya. (Musnad Ahmad). Yeh hadith sabit hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne fatah-e-Makkah ke din farmaya hijrat nahin rahi, haan jihad aur niyat hai, jab tumhein chalne ko kaha jaye uth khade ho jaya karo. (Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim). Sharif mein yeh hadith majood hai. Haan yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jin baaz sahaba ne Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ke samne is surat ka yeh matlab bayan kiya ke jab hum par Allah Ta'ala shahar aur qilay fatah kar de aur hamari madad farmaye toh hamein hukm mil raha hai ke hum is ki tareefein bayan karein, is ka shukr karein aur is ki pakeezgi bayan karein, namaz ada karein aur apne gunahon ki bakhshish talab karein, yeh matlab bhi bilkul sahi hai aur yeh tafsir bhi nihayat pyari hai. Dekho Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne fatah-e-Makkah wale din duha ke waqt aath rakat namaz ada ki. Go log yeh kehte hain ke yeh duha ki namaz thi, lekin hum keh sakte hain ke duha ki namaz aap hamesha nahin padhte the, phir us din jabke shughl aur kaam bahut zyada tha, musafirat thi, yeh kaise padhi? Aap ki iqamat fatah ke mauqa par Makkah Sharif mein Ramzan Sharif ke aakhir tak unnis din rahi, aap farz namaz ko bhi qasr karte rahe, roza bhi nahin rakha aur tamam lashkar jo taqreeban das hazar tha isi tarah karta raha. In haqaiq se yeh baat saaf sabit ho jati hai ke yeh namaz fatah ke shukriye ki namaz thi. Isi liye sardar-e-lashkar, imam-e-waqt par mustahab hai ke jab koi shahar fatah ho toh dakhil hote hi do rakat namaz ada kare. Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ne fatah-e-Madain wale din aisa hi kiya tha. In aath rakaat ko do do rakat kar ke ada kare, go baaz ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke aathon ek hi salam se padh le, lekin Abu Dawood ki hadith sarahatan marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is namaz mein har do rakat ke baad salam phera hai. Dusri tafsir bhi sahi hai jo Ibn Abbas (R.A) wagaira ne ki hai ke is mein aap ko aap ke wisal ki khabar di gayi ke jab aap apni basti Makkah fatah kar lein jahan se in kuffar ne aap ko nikal jane par majboor kiya tha aur aap apni aankhon apni mehnat ka phal dekh lein ke faujon ki faujein aap ke jhande tale aa jayen, joq dar joq log halqa-ba-gosh-e-Islam ho jayen toh hamari taraf aane ki aur hum se mulaqat ki tayariyon mein lag jao. Samajh lo ke jo kaam hamein tum se lena tha poora ho chuka, ab aakhirat ki taraf nigahain dalo jahan aap ke liye bahut behtari hai aur is duniya se bahut zyada bhalai aap ke liye wahan hai, wahin aap ki mehmani tayar hai aur mujh jaisa mezban hai. Tum in nishanat ko dekh kar bakasrat meri hamd-o-sana karo aur tauba-o-istighfar mein lag jao. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se marwi hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne ruku-o-sajde mein ba-kasrat Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika Allahummaghfirli padha karte the. Aap Quran ki is ayat Fasabbih bihamdi Rabbika par amal karte the. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni aakhri umar mein in kalmat ka aksar wird karte the: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilaih. Allah ki zaat pak hai, isi ke liye sab tareefein mukhtas hain, main Allah se istighfar karta hoon aur us ki taraf jhukta hoon. Aur farmaya karte the ke mere Rabb ne mujhe hukm de rakha hai ke jab main yeh alamat dekh loon ke Makkah fatah ho gaya aur deen-e-Islam mein faujein ki faujein dakhil hone lagin toh main in kalmat ko ba-kasrat kahoon, chunancha bihamdillah main ise dekh chuka, lehaza ab is wazifay mein mashghool hoon. (Musnad Ahmad). Ibn Jarir mein Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni aakhri umar mein baithte uthte, chalte phirte, aate jate Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi padha karte. Main ne ek martaba pucha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ki kya wajah hai? Toh aap ne is surat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya mujhe hukm-e-Ilahi yahi hai. Kisi majlis mein baithein phir woh majlis barkhast ho toh kya padhna chahiye, ise hum apni ek mustaqil tasneef mein likh chuke hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jab yeh surat utri toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ise aksar apni namaz mein tilawat karte aur ruku mein teen martaba yeh padhte: Subhanakallahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika Allahummaghfirli innaka antat-tawwabur-raheem. Fatah se murad yahan fatah-e-Makkah hai, is par ittefaq hai. Umooman Arab qabail isi ke muntazir the ke agar yeh apni qaum par ghalib aa jayen aur Makkah in ke zer-e-nageen aa jaye toh phir in ke Nabi hone mein zara sa bhi shuba nahin. Ab jabke Allah ne apne Habib ke hathon Makkah fatah kara diya toh yeh sab Islam mein aa gaye. Is ke baad do saal bhi poore nahin hue the ke sara Arab musalman ho gaya aur har ek qabile mein Islam apna raaj karne laga, Falhamdulillah. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhi Hazrat Umar bin Salama ka yeh maqoola majood hai ke Makkah fatah hote hi har qabile ne Islam ki taraf sabqat ki. In sab ko isi baat ka intezar tha aur kehte the ke inhe aur in ki qaum ko chhodo, dekho agar yeh Nabi-e-Barhaq hain toh apni qaum par ghalib aa jayen ge aur Makkah par in ka jhanda nasb ho jayega. "Hum ne ghazwa-e-fatah-e-Makkah ka poora poora waqia tafseel ke sath apni Seerat ki kitab mein likha hai, jo sahib tafseelat dekhna chahein woh is kitab ko dekh lein." Falhamdulillah. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ke padosi jab apne kisi safar se wapas aaye toh Hazrat Jabir (R.A) un se mulaqat karne ke liye gaye. Unhon ne logon ki phoot aur in ke ikhtilaf ka haal bayan kiya aur in ki nau-ijad bid'aton ka tazkira kiya toh Sahabi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye aur rote hue farmane lage ke main ne Allah ke Habib, Shafe-e-Roz-e-Jaza Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fidahu abi wa ummi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke logon ki faujon ki faujein Allah ke deen mein dakhil huin lekin anqareeb jamaton ki jamatein in mein se nikalne bhi lag jayengi. Is surat ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah-e-ala ihsanihi.
